topic.title: Offshore Wind / Marine Energy / Seabed Rights

scope_guards: A leasing round area is not treated as an awarded seabed lease.
An option agreement is not treated as development consent.
A scoping opinion is not treated as an accepted environmental statement.
A DCO application is not treated as consent.
A marine licence is not treated as grid connection or construction completion.
A compensation proposal is not treated as secured ecological compensation.
Turbine installation is not treated as commissioned generation.
No score or promotion is written without exact lease, consents, construction, grid, commissioning and operational output.
